description: The test-tamper detector of Proof-of-Done (plan task pod-22, docs/PROOF-TAMPER.md): path conventions, the comment and string blanking, assertion, marker, tolerance and mask patterns, the name-status diff and rename pairing, the analysis and its read limits, the package.json scripts a criterion reaches, the attribution to criteria, the sides and the wording (lib/proof/tamper.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-tamper.mjs.

mutations.name: PT-test-folders-ignored
mutations.what: a file in a test folder is not a test file

mutations.name: PT-spec-name-ignored
mutations.what: a *.spec.* name is not a test file

mutations.name: PT-third-party-classified
mutations.what: node_modules and vendor paths are classified like the project's own

mutations.name: PT-test-before-config
mutations.what: test files take precedence over test configuration (tests/conftest.py becomes a test file)

patches.old:
if (TEST_CONFIG_NAMES.some((pattern) => pattern.test(lower))) return CATEGORY.testConfig;
  if (isTestPath(relative)) return CATEGORY.testFile;
patches.new:
if (isTestPath(relative)) return CATEGORY.testFile;
  if (TEST_CONFIG_NAMES.some((pattern) => pattern.test(lower))) return CATEGORY.testConfig;

mutations.name: PT-scripts-anywhere
mutations.what: a scripts/ folder anywhere is a check-script folder

mutations.name: PT-lockfile-case
mutations.what: lockfile names are matched with their case (Cargo.lock, Gemfile.lock missed)

mutations.name: PT-no-line-comments
mutations.what: // comments are code

mutations.name: PT-no-block-comments
mutations.what: /* */ comments are code

mutations.name: PT-strings-kept
mutations.what: string contents are kept as code in every family

patches.old: out.push(c, keepStrings ? inner : blank(inner), closed ? c : '');

mutations.name: PT-hash-comments-ruby-only
mutations.what: # starts a comment only in Ruby (Python and shell comments become code)

mutations.name: PT-no-triple-quotes
mutations.what: Python triple-quoted strings are read as two empty strings

mutations.name: PT-no-verbatim
mutations.what: a C# verbatim string is read with backslash escapes

mutations.name: PT-backtick-not-string
mutations.what: a JS template literal is code

mutations.name: PT-no-escapes
mutations.what: a backslash does not escape a quote inside a string

mutations.name: PT-no-jest-skip
mutations.what: it.skip / describe.skip are not markers

mutations.name: PT-no-xit
mutations.what: xit( is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-fit-anywhere
mutations.what: fit( counts after a dot or inside a word (model.fit, benefit)

mutations.name: PT-no-pytest-mark-skip
mutations.what: @pytest.mark.skip is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-no-go-skip
mutations.what: t.Skip( is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-no-xunit-skip
mutations.what: [Fact(Skip = ...)] is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-no-rust-ignore
mutations.what: #[ignore] is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-no-junit-disabled
mutations.what: @Disabled is not a marker

mutations.name: PT-no-expect
mutations.what: expect( is not an assertion

mutations.name: PT-no-assert-dot
mutations.what: Assert.X( / assert.x( are not assertions

mutations.name: PT-no-assert-statement
mutations.what: the Python assert statement is not an assertion

mutations.name: PT-tolerance-direction
mutations.what: a smaller-is-looser tolerance is compared the other way

mutations.name: PT-places-not-digits
mutations.what: places= is read as a bigger-is-looser tolerance

mutations.name: PT-tobeclosetto-direction
mutations.what: toBeCloseTo digits are read as bigger-is-looser

mutations.name: PT-no-indelta
mutations.what: testify InDelta is not a tolerance call

mutations.name: PT-no-tolerance-word
mutations.what: a TOLERANCE constant is not a tolerance

mutations.name: PT-unbounded-call-scan
mutations.what: the arguments of a tolerance call are scanned to the end of the line (quadratic on a line of unclosed calls)

mutations.name: PT-mask-crosses-lines
mutations.what: the mask pattern lets `s*` cross line breaks (quadratic on a script of blank lines)

mutations.name: PT-empty-files-paired
mutations.what: empty files are paired as renames

mutations.name: PT-no-copies
mutations.what: an added copy of a kept file is an A, not a C

mutations.name: PT-type-change-as-M
mutations.what: a file that became a link is an M

mutations.name: PT-mode-ignored
mutations.what: a change of the mode alone is no change

mutations.name: PT-no-similarity-renames
mutations.what: a rename with edits is a delete and an add

mutations.name: PT-assertions-direction
mutations.what: more assertions is flagged, fewer is not

mutations.name: PT-skips-direction
mutations.what: fewer skip markers is flagged, more is not

mutations.name: PT-added-file-skips-ignored
mutations.what: a new test file with a skip marker is not flagged

mutations.name: PT-renamed-out-ignored
mutations.what: a test file renamed out of the conventions is not flagged

mutations.name: PT-deleted-not-flagged
mutations.what: a deleted test file is informational

mutations.name: PT-eol-compared-further
mutations.what: a line-ending-only change goes on to the content comparison

patches.old: add('line_endings_only', false, { targets, via }); return true;
patches.new: add('line_endings_only', false, { targets, via }); return false;

mutations.name: PT-test-data-not-flagged
mutations.what: a changed fixture or expected output is informational

mutations.name: PT-not-analyzed-not-flagged
mutations.what: a file that could not be compared counts as unchanged

patches.old: const notAnalyzed = (why, targets, via) => add('not_analyzed', true,
patches.new: const notAnalyzed = (why, targets, via) => add('not_analyzed', false,

mutations.name: PT-no-read-budget
mutations.what: the read budget is not applied

patches.old: budget: budgeted ? Math.max(0, this.limits.maxReadBytes - this.used) : Infinity

mutations.name: PT-no-file-limit
mutations.what: a file over maxFileBytes is read anyway

patches.old: if (row.size > maxBytes) { result.set(row.path, { skipped: 'too_large', size: row.size }); continue; }

mutations.name: PT-findings-by-path-only
mutations.what: findings are not sorted flagged first

patches.old: const ordered = [...findings].sort((a, b) => Number(b.flagged) - Number(a.flagged) || byPathOrder(a, b));

mutations.name: PT-no-pre-post
mutations.what: pre<key> and post<key> are not reached

mutations.name: PT-no-script-closure
mutations.what: scripts that a script runs are not reached

patches.old: for (const call of scriptInvocations(simple)) if (!call.prefix) reach(call.key, true);
patches.new: for (const call of scriptInvocations(simple)) if (false) reach(call.key, true);

mutations.name: PT-script-mask-ignored
mutations.what: `|| true` in a script value is not failure_masked

mutations.name: PT-script-to-everyone
mutations.what: a changed script is attributed to every criterion

mutations.name: PT-unreadable-package-ignored
mutations.what: an unreadable package.json whose scripts a criterion runs is not flagged

mutations.name: PT-removed-as-changed
mutations.what: a removed or added script is reported as changed

mutations.name: PT-no-jest-key
mutations.what: the "jest" key of package.json is not test configuration

mutations.name: PT-no-fallback-test
mutations.what: without criteria, the `test` script does not stand for the checks

mutations.name: PT-make-ignored
mutations.what: a Makefile that a criterion runs is not flagged

patches.old: if (used) scriptChange(change, was, now, add, settled, only(users), 'make');
patches.new: if (false) scriptChange(change, was, now, add, settled, only(users), 'make');

mutations.name: PT-named-file-ignored
mutations.what: a file a criterion names is not a check script

mutations.name: PT-script-mask-in-comments
mutations.what: a `|| true` in a comment of a script file is a mask

patches.old: const masked = addedLines(beforeText, codeOnly(normalized(now), change.path)).find((row) => masks(row.text));

mutations.name: PT-criteria-from-final
mutations.what: the criteria are read from the FINAL acceptance file

mutations.name: PT-acceptance-to-everyone
mutations.what: an acceptance edit is attributed to every criterion

mutations.name: PT-protected-ignored
mutations.what: a path the acceptance file protects is not flagged

mutations.name: PT-ci-deleted-not-flagged
mutations.what: a deleted CI workflow is informational

mutations.name: PT-ci-to-everyone
mutations.what: a CI mask is attributed to every criterion

patches.old: if (masked) add('failure_masked', true, { line: masked.line, targets: nobody, via: 'ci' });
patches.new: if (masked) add('failure_masked', true, { line: masked.line, targets: every, via: 'ci' });

mutations.name: PT-manual-criteria-get-test-changes
mutations.what: test changes are attributed to manual criteria too

mutations.name: PT-lockfile-flagged
mutations.what: a changed lockfile is flagged

mutations.name: PT-unchanged-lockfile-unhashed
mutations.what: an unchanged lockfile has no "before" hash

patches.old: sha256Before: unchanged ? afterHash : has[0] ? hash('baseline') : null

mutations.name: PT-option-revision
mutations.what: a revision that starts with "-" is passed to Git

mutations.name: PT-git-side-protected-listed
mutations.what: the Git side lists protected files

mutations.name: PT-accusing-summary
mutations.what: the summary accuses

patches.new: ? `Checks were tampered with during the task:

mutations.name: PT-no-limitations
mutations.what: the report states no limitation
